name: Summit AZ - AEO Audit Chandler Pages 2026-05-29
body:
> Audit · Summit Az · 2026-05-29

# Summary
Script-generated AEO/GEO/SEO grade for the 12 Chandler canonical service pages (one per service line). Every page scored NEEDS WORK or PARTIAL. The 2026-06-23 audit later marked the schema and H1 lines stale after fixes shipped.

# Key findings
- General Plumbing Chandler (1,603 words): no FAQ at all, 0 local entities, no schema. NEEDS WORK.
- Pipe Lining and Tankless: H1 count 0. Water Softeners: H1 count 3. All NEEDS WORK.
- Drain Cleaning, Emergency, Sewer, Water Pressure, Leak Detection, Water Heaters, Garbage Disposals, Fixture Installation: PARTIAL. Visible FAQs (5 to 8 questions) but no Service, FAQPage or LocalBusiness JSON-LD and 0 to 1 local entities.
- Target: 3+ local entities (utility, neighborhood) per page.
- Duplicate-title example: the emergency page title "Emergency Plumbing Services in Arizona | Emergency Plumber" was shared across cities.

# What followed
Per-city FAQ and schema packs in [Summit AZ - Drafts - General Plumbing Update Packs](lib:brain-summit-az-drafts-general-plumbing-update-packs) and the `_apply_schema.php` scripts in [Summit AZ - Drafts Folder Overview](lib:brain-summit-az-drafts-folder-overview).
